methodology: Enumerated live from tools/cat_* *_records() on this machine. AVAILABLE+backend+exact tool_id reference in tests/*.py => IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED. AVAILABLE+backend without direct reference => IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED. AVAILABLE with no backend => INTERFACE_ONLY. Declared PROVIDER_REQUIRED/MODEL_REQUIRED/NOT_INSTALLED/DISABLED/DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM/ADMIN_REQUIRED pass through unchanged.

tools.limitations: approval-gated: explicit owner approval required; network pairing transport interface-only in v0.7

classification_criteria.IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: AVAILABLE with real backend AND exact tool_id referenced in tests/*.py
classification_criteria.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: AVAILABLE with real backend, no direct tool_id test reference
classification_criteria.INTERFACE_ONLY: AVAILABLE declaration with no backend (definition only)
classification_criteria.MODEL_REQUIRED: Declared; needs AI model capability (not available)
classification_criteria.ADMIN_REQUIRED: Declared; admin gating lives in profiles/policy, no record flags it

key_findings: Zero tools claim AVAILABLE without a backend.
http.head/post/put/patch/delete/upload and web.* are honestly PROVIDER_REQUIRED, not AVAILABLE.
Node pairing ops are DISABLED/approval-gated, not advertised as available.
IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED is intentionally strict (exact tool_id test reference).
